title: Temperature converter
prompt: Implement two methods: `toCelsius(double f)` = `(f - 32) * 5 / 9` and `toFahrenheit(double c)` = `c * 9 / 5 + 32`. Results must be exact doubles.

tests.name: freezing point round trip
tests.hint: Both formulas at the freezing point.

tests.name: round trip identity
tests.hint: Convert there and back — you must land exactly where you started.
